main.description: Report which fields of the authenticated user's app.bsky.actor.profile record could be imported onto their social.coves.actor.profile record, and whether the import should be offered. Both records are read from the user's PDS.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: The request is not authenticated.

errors.name: ServiceUnavailable
errors.description: The session store is temporarily unavailable; retry.

errors.name: MissingCredentials
errors.description: The session has no PDS host; sign in again.

errors.name: SessionError
errors.description: The user's PDS session could not be restored; sign in again.

errors.name: SessionBusy
errors.description: Another request is using the session; retry.

errors.name: AuthExpired
errors.description: The user's PDS session expired while reading a profile record; sign in again.

errors.name: PermissionDenied
errors.description: The session does not have permission to read the profile records.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The user's PDS rate-limited the read; retry later.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The user's PDS rejected a request as invalid.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: The user's PDS answered a read with a conflict; retry.

errors.name: PayloadTooLarge
errors.description: The user's PDS answered a read with a payload-too-large error.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The user's PDS answered with a server error or an unusable response (over 1 MiB, undecodable, or a 404 without an XRPC error).

errors.name: PDSError
errors.description: The user's PDS could not be reached.

errors.name: AccountNotFound
errors.description: The authenticated user has no Coves account record.

errors.name: InvalidDID
errors.description: The authenticated user's DID is not valid.

errors.name: Timeout
errors.description: The request timed out.

errors.name: RequestCanceled
errors.description: The request was canceled.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The PDS client could not read the profile records.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: The import dismissal state could not be read, or the response could not be encoded.

errors.name: MethodNotAllowed
errors.description: The request method is not GET.

status.description: noBlueskyProfile: no Bluesky profile record. nothingToImport: the Bluesky profile has no importable field. dismissed: the user dismissed or completed the import. complete: every importable field is already set on Coves. offer: at least one importable field is empty on Coves.

fields.description: Importable Bluesky fields in the order displayName, description, avatar, banner. Empty for noBlueskyProfile and nothingToImport.

bluesky.description: The Bluesky value of a text field. Absent for image fields.

blueskyImageUrl.description: Preview URL of the Bluesky image for avatar and banner. Absent for text fields.

covesIsEmpty.description: Whether the field is unset on the user's Coves profile.
